body.name: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{grow}}\)
body.construction: Analyze a spectrally regularized projection of the empirical cycle score \(\widehat\kappa\) using the eigenspaces of \(\widehat K\), with bias controlled by the discarded cycle loading \(\widehat b_{\mathrm{cyc}}\) and stochastic error controlled by a self-normalized graph-cycle central limit argument
inputs: the empirical cycle triple \((\widehat K,\widehat b_{\mathrm{cyc}},\widehat\kappa)\)
a sequence of growing untreated graphs
